title: Easton Press - The Mill on the Floss By George Eliot Collector’s Edition 1980
descriptionText: This is a collector's edition of "The Mill on the Floss" by George Eliot, published by Easton Press in 1980. The book is bound in leather and features illustrations by Wray Manning. It is an original printing and not a facsimile, written in English and printed in the United States. The book is classified as a classic and falls under the categories of Books & Magazines and Antiquarian & Collectible. The author, George Eliot, is known for her masterful storytelling and this book is a must-have for any literature and fiction enthusiast.
